resources.string: ✓ Confirmed: This app is the Always-on VPN
\? System started the service, but tunnel not established — cannot confirm isAlwaysOn
\? System started the service, but isAlwaysOn returns false
\? Service running, but not started by system

isAlwaysOn and isLockdownEnabled only return correct values after the tunnel is connected.\nYou can use "Start Service" first to observe, then "Connect Tunnel" to compare.\n"Started by System" can also be used to determine Always-on status — if the system starts this service with the VpnService intent, it means the app is configured as Always-on VPN in system settings.
